title: Durable per-member skill completion ledger + Space to next needing Sim
observation: Host revisited already-maxed skills on the same Sim when household skill-force was restarted.
N is the observed household portrait count; do not invent an 8/10 member ceiling.
Holistic host sense: know which skills are already done, skip them, Space to the next Sim that still needs work.
decision: Own a repository-wide completion ledger under dist/game-host (diy-skill-force-completion.json) keyed by session_id + member index/key.
After each stats.set_skill_level cheat is typed, record DISPATCHED at target level for that member/skill.
On plan/execute, omit skills already DISPATCHED or PANEL_OBSERVED_MAX at target; if a member has none left, skip console dispatch and Space to the next needing member.
DISPATCHED is resume evidence only — Skills-panel LOCAL_OBSERVED remains the sole PASS. --redo forces a full re-dispatch. Not a second skill owner.
